comments.text:
as per my research only 2 major drawbacks in star comprehensive compared with other companies policy. 

1. Restore instead of Recharge which makes it almost useless feature as the restore benefit will only trigger once an year after exhausting complete sum insured not partially which means if your 2nd claim is more than the remaining balance of sum insured + NCB you have to pay from your pocket.
2. Sub limits on modern treatments which are way costlier than these defined sub limits makes it less useful feature at least they should have allowed till sum insured like other companies do.

They should provide these benefits with additional premium or give these options as additional riders with some extra amount.

comments.text:
Hi,




I took star health comprehensive family insurance , paid Rs. 36000/ year from 2018 for 25 Lacks coverage. When i went for my first claim in past 3 years what i understood that.





1. star is the worst among all other health insurance 
2. Escalations to even IRDA , did not went well 
3. They put deductions on my bill , i was forced to pay .. i mentioned the non coverable items below 





patients diagnosis was : 4 year old child sustained head injury , for plastic surgery 






1.	OT consumables ( Patient was admitted for surgery and denied OT consumable charge )

2.	Hand wash (Chlorohexidine  liquid gel is for the skin preparation of the patient for infection prevention and hygiene prior to surgery ) 





3.	Examination gloves ( Wound examination need gloves , otherwise it can cause cross contamination and infection )





4.	ECG electrode ( ECG electrodes is a basic thing to monitor the client in the Operation theatre to the ECG, BP, SPO2, Respiration, Pulse rate  monitor 





5.	Admission services ( After admission only the insurance is applicable as cashless and it’s denied )





6.	Equipment usage charge ( The medical equipment usage requires , charges and fees and it’s denied ) 





7.	Id band ( ID band is the only one tool for patient identification in the hospital dress , all patients cloths and valuables will be in safety locker or in the  room for surgery preparation , patients are not going to operation theatre with voters id card or Aadhar card )





8.	Medical records charge ( Medical records either paper or electronic are legible source of information’s recorded in the hospital , without that how can we review or record an event )





9.	Ed bed charge  ( Trauma victims are not seen in the psychiatric OPD’s , they are assessed and stabilsed in the Emergency department until there is a disposition to admission or discharge ,that requires plenty of ED admission time for assessment , reassessment , planning , examinations by different specialties, radiological and lab investigations  ,  until that moment the client will be in ED , how it’s possible to deny that charges





There's no hospitals built for not charging the above mentioned items 






In my experience 





Check with your Health insurance agents about the deductions before purchasing it. 





They're professional scammers , they will trap you in many places ... when it comes for insurance claim..





"Always understand the exclusions " 





never trust the sweet words of insurance agents

should you require any further clarifications kindly contact me . All the things mentioned above is evidence based and with proof of communications.. 

NB : It's my personal experience , shared because these points may be helpful for someone interested to buy policy ...I believe an ideal Youtuber must explain about what i mentioned above , or they must tell the darker side of the health insurance agents ... i wish someone will be there in this media world who's interested to look into the malpractices rather than doing 100% sincere paid promotions .....
